name: civic-agent-kit
description: MCP server for Kenya civic data — 6 tools covering county drought phases, budget allocation, parliament bills, SACCO registry, constitutional rights (English/Swahili), and the 47 counties list. Part of the East Africa AI infrastructure stack.

tools.name: kenya_county_drought
tools.description: NDMA drought phase for any Kenya county (1=Minimal → 5=Famine). Supports English/Swahili.

tools.name: kenya_budget_summary
tools.description: County budget allocation, development/recurrent split, absorption rate. FY 2022/23 from Controller of Budget.

tools.name: kenya_parliament_bills
tools.description: Kenya Parliament bills — filter by status or keyword. Returns title, status, type, date, summary.

tools.name: kenya_sacco_lookup
tools.description: SASRA SACCO registry — search by name or county. Returns membership, assets, type.

tools.name: kenya_rights_query
tools.description: Kenya constitutional rights from Chapter 4 — land, water, health, education, labour, housing, food. English and Swahili.
